text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even in victory, Mejiro Ardan was left 
deeply impressed by the terrifying
prowess 
of Oguri Cap and the others.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While praising each other's efforts,
Inari 
One reveals that all members of the 
"Eternal Top Three" will gather at the 
upcoming Tenno Sho (Autumn).

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ardan's heart races at the thought 
of the "Eternal Big Three" gathering in 
one place. The focal point of history,
the 
Tenno Sho (Autumn), was just around the 
corner—
